text:
maria: Quick q — during the new org onboarding we show service account keys in the console. Legal flagged this as a potential data exposure for orgs that want 'ephemeral-only' keys. Can we change the default visibility?

ben: We currently show the key once and then hide it, but the download link is still in the audit trail. Do they want the console to not keep any retrievable record at all?

maria: Exactly. They asked for a 'one-time-download' default + telemetry that proves who downloaded. Right now we log SA key creation but not the actual download event.

kai: That will impact support flows. If the original key is unobtainable after creation, support can't re-provide it. We'd need a clear rotate/create-recovery pattern documented.

sophie: Also a quota concern — some teams spin ephemeral keys per CI job and that can blow up our key-per-day counters. We should think per-project+service-account rate limits.

ben: Proposal: add a checkbox in the create-key UI: "Create key (one-time download)". If checked, we store only a salted key-hash and never persist plaintext. Emit a telemetry event `sa.key_downloaded` with hashed identifiers and the actor.

alex: Telemetry hygiene: ensure we don't send raw SA ids or key material. Use a salted HMAC of (org|project|sa|actor) and sample high-volume orgs. GDPR/ERASURE: make hashes revocable by removing salt.

maria: Rollout plan idea: opt-in flag for 2 weeks, then default-on for new orgs, followed by a full rollout. Canary should avoid orgs with >100 active keys to prevent surprising large customers.

ops-bot: Deploy note: canary tag `canary/ephemeral-sa-key-default` will go to console-frontend v2 and authsvc v6. Watch `authsvc.key_events` stream.

kai: Backend changes: token exchange endpoints remain the same. Key creation endpoint must return plaintext once and then redact. Rotation endpoint creates a new key copy (returned once) and revokes the old one.

sophie: Quota specifics suggestion: default 100 ephemeral keys/day per project, adjustable via enterprise settings. Emit `quota.ephemeral_key_exceeded` with sampling for noisy tenants.

ben: Implementation checklist (initial):
- authsvc: persist key-hash + creation metadata, never store plaintext post-return
- events: `sa.key_created`, `sa.key_downloaded`, `sa.key_rotated`, `sa.key_revoked`, `quota.ephemeral_key_exceeded`
- console: updated create-key UX + help copy + one-time-copy banner
- telemetry: sampling rules + HMACed identifiers + GDPR scrub hook
- rollout: feature flag `ephemeral_sa_key_by_default` + canary plan

maria: I'll draft the rollout doc and a sample telemetry schema. Who owns the backend work?

kai: I'll take backend. I'll sketch DB migration (add key_hash, download_count, retention TTL) and retention policy: keep key-hash 365 days, keep creation audit for 2 years, scrub raw link traces.

alex: I'll own telemetry: wire the `sa.key_downloaded` event, add sampling for top 5% churn orgs, ensure no PII leaks in traces.

sophie: I'll add quota config and create a Console dashboard tile: per-project key churn heatmap + top ephemeral key creators.

maria: Great. Action items captured. I'll ping @product-team once I have the rollout doc. :thumbsup:

ben: small UX ask — show a clear warning in the modal: "This key will only be shown once. If you lose it, you'll need to rotate and update consumers."

kai: also document support flow: we can create a replacement key, but we cannot recover the original. Ops runbook to include `authsvc.recreate_key_for_support` with audit annotation.

maria: Thanks all — I'll send the doc + proposed timeline. If anyone has objections to the telemetry fields I listed, reply here.

alex: LGTM on fields. I'll also add a GDPR endpoint to handle hash salt revocation.

sophie: I'll prototype the dashboard next week and link the mock in #design.

maria: Perfect. Closing out here — follow-ups in the rollout doc.
